'''Army C''' was part of the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]], consisting of [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]] and [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transports]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], it was sent to [[Battle of the south ridge|flank]] the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] during the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Grassy Plains]]. Army C was destroyed by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]], a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]].

==Behind the scenes==
Army C first appeared in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''. It was identified in a diagram of the Battle of Grassy Plains in the reference book ''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''.
